'''Attack Formation Seven''' was an [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] combat tactic used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], deployed by a front row of kneeling troopers, and a back row of standing troopers.
